# Close wrap, Mon Oct 19, 2026 (Research Inc., ~4:25 PM ET)

**Tone: AI and chips bounce back from their worst week since June, but the rally is narrow and most of the market fell.**

1. **Indexes:** S&P 500 +0.4% to 7,690.73, Nasdaq +1.1%, Dow −0.04% to 51,966; IWM +0.3%, VIX 18.4 (−7.9%). ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/wall-street-stocks-dow-nasdaq-5aec11ee466841cc2a69b2d23ab77f0e), [AP story](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-oil-us-ai-494fbe4361a0360b2f6368e7a6d8f058), box yfinance)
2. **Sectors:** Seven of 11 S&P sectors fell. XLY +1.8% (AMZN, TSLA +3.8%) and XLK +1.3% led; XLU −2.0%, XLRE −1.2%, XLF −0.8%. 10y ~5.14%. ([Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/wall-st-futures-climb-as-ai-stocks-rebound-oil-yields-fall-4956777), box yfinance)
3. **Chips:** SMH +1.6% after nine straight down days; MU +3%, INTC +2.4% (JPM to Neutral), NVDA +1.4%. CRWV −0.4% even with a Goldman upgrade to Buy (PT $106). ([CNBC midday](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/19/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-midday-sndk-mrvl-ddog-clf-amzn.html))
4. **Covered movers:** AMZN +5.0% (Morgan Stanley top pick, AWS acceleration), DDOG +5.4% (Bernstein Outperform), CLF +16.3% (Q3 adj EPS $0.28 vs $0.21; Q4 EBITDA guide $715M, 2027 >$4B), BAC −1.6%, JPM −1.8%, META −0.6% before Wednesday's report. ([CNBC midday](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/19/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-midday-sndk-mrvl-ddog-clf-amzn.html), [X news](https://x.com/i/trending/2112146418362187820))
5. **Oil/after hours:** WTI ~$98.5 (−2.9%), Brent ~$109.4. After the close, STLD, WRB, ZION and WAL report; no covered large caps. ([Digrin](https://www.digrin.com/stocks/earnings_calendar/2026-10-19))

**Tomorrow:** housing starts 8:30; GE/GM/RTX/MMM/NOC/HAL BMO; NFLX, SpaceX, ISRG, UAL, ALK, COF AMC.

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **CLF**: big beat plus 2027 EBITDA >$4B guide; post-earnings drift setup. Conf: low. Risk: +16% gap can fade from the open; Canada's Stelco legal threat.

**Holds, no re-add:** AMZN, DDOG (+5% in a day), BLK, XLP, WMT, UNH. **Avoids kept:** semis/memory, AI optics, AI-debt infra (LRCX/TXN Wed), airlines (Brent ~$109), BAC.
